prompts.master:
Use case: strong style-transfer. Image1 (BLONDE RIA) is the ABSOLUTE DRAWING TEMPLATE, controlling facial drawing, outlines, all surface shading and finish. Image2 is ONLY a character identity/outfit brief; its drawing style MUST BE DISCARDED. Rebuild image2 as if the exact illustrator drew another heroine on the SAME MODEL SHEET as image1. This MUST visibly change the previous face/rendering, NOT preserve image2's old illustration and merely recolor it.
Match image1's facial construction and marks: broad softly rounded horizontally wide adult anime eyes with relaxed upper eyelids, simple flat-gradient irises with ONLY restrained highlights, thin minimal brows, tiny simplified triangular/pale nose mark with NO modeled bridge/nostril, small closed mouth as ONE delicate curved line with NO rendered glossy lips, compact soft oval grown-adult jaw and shorter chin. Keep character's own eye COLOR and hair identity, not image2's old sharp realistic nose/lips/narrow eye rendering. Same small detail density as Ria. Entire head-to-shoes image: Ria's thin muted clean contour weight, simplified hair into broad controlled color blocks rather than dense strands, pale flat skin with broad restrained softly edged CEL shadow shapes, NO airbrushed 3D anatomy or glossy orange skin. Cloth uses broad quiet 2-tone shadows and minimal simple fold lines; REDUCE the old shirt's intricate wrinkles and shiny highlights. Shoes must match Ria's MATTE restrained finish: one soft small highlight at most, NO bright white reflection stripe, no multi-reflection specular modeling, no glossy patent rendering even if original shoes were shiny. Keep character clothing design and color, but illustrate ALL material surfaces in the same Ria finish. Reconstruct mature adult natural 7-to-7.5-head body proportions from Ria template. Neutral front-facing upright stance with level shoulders/hips, arms gently down, uncrossed legs and feet slightly apart. Fully clothed ADULT, no chibi/juvenile. Each hand has exactly four fingers plus thumb with natural occlusion, rounded ends, simple short nails. Ears have ONE smooth natural lobe, NO flesh-colored bead/double lobe; jewelry attaches directly without skin knob. Complete centered head-to-shoes sprite on genuine transparent background, no aura/glow/floor/scenery/text. Character Han Seoyun: BROWN irises, BROWN loose low bun and side strands, tiny beauty mark near mouth. Keep light-blue button shirt over white camisole, taupe long cardigan pushed-up sleeves, cream wide straight trousers, BLACK gold-bit loafers with MATTE simple shading, dark round watch on viewer-right wrist, one thin gold hoop each visible ear. No tablet in neutral master. Face must be redrawn in RIA face grammar rather than preserved previous Seoyun face.
